action_inputs.description: Azure RBAC role the identity gets on this namespace, with Namespace User: Writer, Reader, or Admin. Ignored on remove.
action_inputs.label: Access Level
action_inputs.name: aks_ns_pipeline_access_level

action_inputs.description: Add creates (or updates) the managed identity, its federated credentials, and its namespace access; remove revokes the access and deletes the identity.
action_inputs.label: Action
action_inputs.name: aks_ns_pipeline_action

action_inputs.description: Only workflows running on this branch may sign in as the identity. Give a branch or a GitHub environment: Azure federated credentials match one exact branch or environment.
action_inputs.label: Branch
action_inputs.name: aks_ns_pipeline_branch

action_inputs.description: Only jobs that reference this GitHub environment may sign in as the identity. Use instead of Branch; protect the environment with deployment rules.
action_inputs.label: GitHub Environment
action_inputs.name: aks_ns_pipeline_environment

action_inputs.description: Repository whose GitHub Actions workflows may sign in as the managed identity, as owner/repo. For a private repository created after July 15, 2026, give owner@OWNER-ID/repo@REPO-ID.
action_inputs.label: GitHub Repository
action_inputs.name: aks_ns_pipeline_repository

description: Creates or deletes a user-assigned managed identity that a GitHub Actions workflow signs in as through OIDC, with kubectl access to an AKS namespace through namespace-scoped Azure RBAC roles.
name: Manage AKS Namespace Pipeline Identity
